trigger.observed_contract_change: DeepSeek documents that thinking is enabled by default, that generated tokens include thinking and final output, and that thinking can be disabled with the documented thinking field. The prior 128-token probe used the default thinking mode and returned no usable message content.
trigger.reason: This one-shot replacement holds the canonical adapter, fixed JSON prompt, model, endpoint, provider-reported identity requirement, and no-data boundary constant while disabling thinking and increasing the fixed-output limit to 256 tokens.

output.provenance: derived from one fixed provider JSON object
output.value: The configured non-thinking canonical execution path returned the exact fixed JSON object with a provider-reported model identity.
output.permitted_loss: No repository, candidate, proposal, retrieval, association, semantic label, raw provider response, or provider error text is retained or sent.
output.failure_behavior: A provider or local contract failure is recorded only as a safe category. If the process is interrupted after attempt start, the durable started record remains and no semantic execution is authorized.

runner.contract: The runner persists a safe started attempt record before the provider call, requires a provider-reported model identity, validates the exact fixed JSON object, and never retains a raw response or error text.

stop_condition: This plan permits one non-semantic probe only. A missing, failed, malformed, or interrupted probe leaves the full PR 208 semantic reference proposed and requires a new reviewed plan before any source-evidence execution.
downstream_gate: Only a successful non-thinking probe may justify a separately frozen, small subject-partition source-evidence review plan. The probe cannot verify a reference, produce semantic FI/FE, or alter production behavior.
